ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx 85% of visible surface; high-intensity (white/light grey) clusters localized at the distal tips and medial right lobe region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is a largely contiguous dark-intensity region. Right lobe displays circular, light-grey mottling in the center-distal region and high-contrast, multi-pixel clusters at the terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 130 degrees and depth of 15-20 pixels; partially obscured by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, irregular peaks with pixel amplitudes of 4-8. Left lobe trailing edge is more linear with at least two distinct V-shaped indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from medial notch to distal tips on both lobes; right lobe exhibits a sharp upward-curving distal terminal.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixels (barnacles) localized on the right and left distal tips. Dispersed circular scarring visible on the interior right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-grey linear streaks visible on the right lobe surface, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) on the distal tips of both lobes; significant irregular chipping and loss of material along the right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Massive vertical accumulation of barnacles on the far-right tip, significantly altering the outer geometric contour.
